name: todo-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Verifies the gateway's signed assertion for each signed-in caller.

description: Ballerina service owning the todo domain. Exposes /me/todos to list and create the caller's own todos and mark one done, scoping every row by the signed-in user's id from the gateway assertion. Does not support editing or deleting a todo, and never sees another user's rows.
